notes: assembled items (ST_STANDS.fmx): ST_ITEM rows with STAND_FLAG = 1 (group permission filter), typed numeric item code without duplicates, one basic unit with factor 1 and unique factors, units used in transactions locked, components (quantity > 0, unit of the component, no duplicate) and services (no duplicate) required at save; delete refused with transactions; total cost panel (ALLOW_VIEW_COST)

validations.name: بيانات الصنف المجمع: المجموعة والاسم ورقم الصنف

ST_ITEM.ITEM_GROUP_CODE.lov: select g.item_group_code || ' - ' || g.name_a d, g.item_group_code r from st_item_group g where g.group_status = 1 and app_rules3_st.group_allowed(g.item_group_code) = 1 order by g.item_group_code

ST_STAND_ITEMS.ITEM_UNIT.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where u.unit_code = iu.unit_code and iu.group_code = :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE and iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE order by u.unit_code

ST_STAND_ITEMS.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(i.name_a) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.item_group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_STAND_ITEMS.ITEM_UNIT_NAME.sql: (select max(u.name_a) from st_unit u where u.unit_code = t.item_unit)

ST_STAND_ITEMS.COST_VALUE.sql: case when app_rules3_st.can_view_cost = 1 then (select avg(nvl(d.unit_cost, 0)) from st_trns_mast m, st_trns_det d, st_trns_type ty where m.trns_type_code = d.trns_type_code and m.trns_serial = d.trns_serial and d.trns_type_code = ty.trns_type_code and ty.effect = 1 and d.item_code = t.item_code and d.group_code = t.item_group_code) * nvl((select max(f.factor) from st_item_unit f where f.group_code = t.item_group_code and f.item_code = t.item_code and f.unit_code = t.item_unit), 1) end

ST_STAND_ITEMS.TOTAL_ITEM_COST.sql: case when app_rules3_st.can_view_cost = 1 then nvl((select avg(nvl(d.unit_cost, 0)) from st_trns_mast m, st_trns_det d, st_trns_type ty where m.trns_type_code = d.trns_type_code and m.trns_serial = d.trns_serial and d.trns_type_code = ty.trns_type_code and ty.effect = 1 and d.item_code = t.item_code and d.group_code = t.item_group_code), 0) * nvl((select max(f.factor) from st_item_unit f where f.group_code = t.item_group_code and f.item_code = t.item_code and f.unit_code = t.item_unit), 1) * nvl(t.item_qty, 0) end

ST_STAND_SERVICES.UNIT_COST.sql: case when app_rules3_st.can_view_cost = 1 then (select max(s.unit_cost) from st_pd_services s where s.service_code = t.service_code) end

ST_STAND_SERVICES.LINE_TOTAL.sql: case when app_rules3_st.can_view_cost = 1 then nvl((select max(s.unit_cost) from st_pd_services s where s.service_code = t.service_code), 0) * nvl(t.units_no, 0) end
